sources.title: aishy26/nppe_3_model · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Low-Light Denoising + 4x Super-Resolution RRDBNet (Real-ESRGAN generator architecture), fine-tuned from Real-ESRGAN's pretrained RealESRGAN_x4plusweights on paired low-light noisy/clean image data. Trained with Charbonnier + SSIM pixel loss only — no adversarial or perceptual loss — since the goal is pixel-accurate reconstruction (PSNR), not hallucinated texture.

sources.title: jagannath-r/dlp-nppe3-denoise-sr · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: DLP NPPE-3: Low-Light Denoising + 4x Super-Resolution DLP NPPE-3: Low-Light Denoising + 4x Super-Resolution Residual CNN with PixelShuffle upsampling. Takes a 256x160 noisy low-light RGB image and outputs a 1024x640 denoised, super-resolved RGB image (4x upsampling in each dimension).
